# Motor Inn of Carroll

> Motor Inn of Carroll is a Chevrolet dealership located in Carroll, Iowa, serving Lake City, Audubon, Arcadia, Coon Rapids, Denison, and surrounding communities with new Chevrolet and pre-owned vehicles, financing, trade appraisals, certified service, and parts.
